reason: A Linux-only DSH Web plugin that periodically samples CPU, memory, and root filesystem usage and displays the cached metrics in a non-interactive page overlay.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 页面右下角实时显示 Linux CPU、内存和根文件系统磁盘占用率的系统监控悬浮窗。
summaries.en: A DSH Web system-monitoring overlay that displays live Linux CPU, memory, and root filesystem disk usage in the bottom-right corner.

capabilities: Reads Linux CPU, memory, and root filesystem usage
Runs periodic local shell-based system metric sampling
Serves cached metrics through a local GET endpoint
Displays metrics in a fixed web-page overlay
